findings.evidence: Resolved in plan.md solution and Task 6: ContextRouteReceipt v3 freezes origin-specific provenance; ordinary StartSnapshot v7 and checkpoint v6 carry exact route JSON/hash; schema 1-6 remains UNROUTED; checkpoint conflicts fail closed with an explicit compatibility/tamper matrix.
findings.root_cause: A2 added a new SDK start authority without freezing its wire, provenance and checkpoint recovery contract.

findings.evidence: Resolved in Task 3/6: pre-claim produces only an inert canonical draft; claim atomically CAS-binds candidate and draft hash while creating host_run/owner/generation/lease; executable authorities are built only from read_claimed_execution and are generation-bound. Negative concurrency/crash tests are frozen.
findings.root_cause: The plan did not separate an inert pre-claim draft from generation-bound post-claim authority.

findings.evidence: Resolved in Task 6 through ForegroundProviderAuthorityPort, ForegroundContextPreparationPort and ForegroundToolAuthorityPort. Their source facts are explicitly canonical and SessionDB is forbidden; execution_session_id is protocol identity only. A composition test makes all SessionDB reads raise.
findings.root_cause: The desired canonical primary/TaskScope source boundary was stated negatively but not expressed as constructor-bound ports.

findings.evidence: Resolved in Task 5: every v44 writer and table is explicitly classified A/B/C/D and added to fence triggers, quiescence/watermarks, typed-leaf manifests and emergency export. Unknown tables/columns fail closed.
findings.root_cause: The A2 schema was appended after the v39-v43 recovery taxonomy had converged.

findings.evidence: Resolved in Task 8: source commit, wheel filename/version/SHA, installed distribution/module origin and public contract manifest are frozen; Host pin files form an identity commit; old 0.7.0/wrong hash fails closed and public-package fresh/duplicate/restart tests are required.
findings.root_cause: A cross-repository candidate dependency needs a post-build identity contract, not only a source change.
